EvidenceSchema.description:
Wire tag of the knowledge documents. Wave K1 writes `evidence.v2`; `evidence.v1` (C0) documents
are still read. An addition of v2 (a field, a relation, a concept node, a new document type) is
refused under the v1 tag, so a v1 reader never receives a document it would misread.

oneOf.description: C0. Still read; new documents are written as v2.

description: `sources_outline`: the section tree of one source, or the subtree under `node_id`.

depth.description: Levels below the root to return; deeper children are flagged, not dropped silently.

node_id.description: Subtree root; absent = the whole document.
